description:
Businesses can use the JustGotThat! for Business app to help grow their services business. We support all types of services that can be dived by increments of time. If a service provider can define their services by price and time, then this platform is built and designed for them.

Service Providers establish a business and get approved to use the platform. From there the set up is simple and intuitive. Businesses add locations, services and resources to their business. We support both physical and mobile locations. The business owner provides certain details about their business that allows us to create relationships between services, locations, resources and more.

Once setup is complete, a schedule is created for each resource by location. The day to day interface a business has is updating resource availability in the schedule provided. With this information, we use algorithms to determine what services are available at what locations. It is this service availability that consumers search for, select and buy all within the platform.

Our app is intended to reduce the amount of money service providers spend on advertising and marketing. We aim to match service demand with service supply in an easy, intuitive user experience that will drive more business to our service provider partners. So, as service providers save money on promoting their business, we are working diligently to drive business to our partners allowing them to focus on what they do best.

Our service coverage includes health and beauty, automotive, home improvement, home maintenance, pet care, and other ad hoc services that people need on a day to day basis.
